title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 25 October 2026
description: Wholesale electricity prices fall despite record winter demand as renewables overtake gas, south-west Queensland roads close amid days of rain, and a Gold Coast driver faces court over a car stopped on tram tracks. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
